Create Google Forms quiz

This creates an unpublished quiz in your Google Drive. Multiple-choice questions include their diagrams, answer choices, and automatic answer keys. Written responses keep their assigned points for teacher grading.

  1. Copy the script below.
  2. Open a new Google Apps Script project and replace the starter code.
  3. Save, run createQuiz, and approve Google’s access request. Open the quiz edit link in the execution log.

Automatic quiz results

One coordinator sets this up once per common assessment. Create a quiz for each teacher or connect one they already use. Scores refresh about every ten minutes, including grades entered later.

Saved PLC member emails are filled in below. Manage PLC team

For existing quizzes, give the coordinator access. Include required Student ID and Class period fields. Scored question titles and points must match the assessment.

  1. Copy the script into a new Apps Script project in your school account.
  2. Run setupQuiz and authorize it. The execution log lists each teacher’s quiz. Keep the script project and its score spreadsheet private to the coordinator.
  3. Deploy as a web app, execute as yourself, with access limited to your school domain. Save its /exec URL below and share that results link with the enrolled teachers.
